name: Ron Chrisley
abstract_title: Bohmian Quantum Neural Networks, Active Information, and Artificial Consciousness
abstract: Quantum active information (QAI, Bohm & Hiley 1993) is a primordial form of mind-like meaning at the most fundamental levels of physical reality, which affords novel ways of understanding the relation between the mental and the physical (Bohm 1990; Hiley & Pylkkänen 2022). Although emphasis to date has been on employing QAI in the understanding of biological, specifically human, consciousness, this talk explores three possibilities that QAI generates for artificial consciousness.
